The structure of ZrCo₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 123), with a unit cell containing five atoms—one Zr and four Co—distributed across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Zr centers have 16 neighbors, and Co polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces with one another. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all five sites.
